history.trigger: The canon plan left open whether sweep records name a role or a topic; the user chose topic, since a sweep studies a topic and roles reuse topics.
history.change: Sweep records say '- Topic: <topic>' instead of '- Role: <role>'; the renderers write it for every record not registered at version 1.

history.trigger: ADR 0011 option A: the canon study found rules held by prose or by one check each.
history.change: The first ledger: 29 rules from the README authoring rules, the gates and the tests, each naming its enforcing test or why it is reviewed; three authoring rules gained checks; every skill, ADR, card and sweep record is registered at version 1 in conformance.json.

rules.text: Every SKILL.md stays at 9,000 characters or fewer.
rules.reason: Skill bodies load into context when invoked; the budget keeps each role affordable.

enforced.title: every SKILL.md stays at 9,000 characters or fewer

rules.notCovered: Reference and shared files a skill reads on demand are not measured.

rules.text: The engine never cites a profile rule by its number.
rules.reason: Each profile numbers its rules its own way, so a number points at the wrong rule elsewhere.

enforced.title: the engine never cites a rule by number, because each profile numbers its rules its own way

rules.notCovered: A rule named by a paraphrase instead of a number is not detected.

rules.text: Every ADR from 0009 on has a Prior art section with pinned evidence, a card per GitHub source and a social source or a no-social line.
rules.reason: A design is chosen after established practice is studied, and the study can be re-checked.

enforced.title: the kit's own ADRs pass

rules.notCovered: Whether the pinned lines still hold on GitHub is checked by prior-art-verify.mjs outside npm test.

rules.text: Every feat or fix commit since the latest tag carries an ADR: or Prior-art: trailer.
rules.reason: Each behaviour change traces to the decision or the study behind it.

enforced.title: the kit's own commits since its latest tag carry their trailers

rules.notCovered: Commits before the latest tag, and whether the named ADR actually covers the change.

rules.text: Every prior-art card is the source of a study row in a sweep record, and every sweep record passes its method checks.
rules.reason: A card without a recorded selection cannot show why that source was studied.

enforced.title: the kit's own sweep records, cards, ADRs, coverage matrix and mechanism tables pass

rules.notCovered: Whether a card's lessons follow from its evidence is a review judgment.

rules.text: Every module with an argv guard exports run, and its guard only calls run.
rules.reason: Tests and shims call run directly, so command-line behaviour stays testable without a subprocess.

enforced.title: every module with an argv guard exports run and its guard only calls run

rules.notCovered: Modules started some other way than the argv guard.

rules.text: Every shim in plugin/scripts names a module that exists, and every guarded module has a shim.
rules.reason: Older paths keep working after a module moves.

enforced.title: every shim in scripts/ names a module that exists, and every guarded module has a shim

rules.notCovered: Paths outside plugin/scripts that users may have saved.

rules.text: Every language pack of the menu labels has exactly the keys of the English pack.
rules.reason: A missing key shows a raw key or the wrong language in a menu.

enforced.title: every language pack has exactly the keys of the English pack

rules.notCovered: Whether a translation means the same as the English label.

rules.text: No gate regex takes longer than 250 ms on a crafted 200,000-character input.
rules.reason: A gate that hangs blocks every tool call it guards.

enforced.title: no gate regex takes longer than 250 ms on a crafted 200,000-character input

rules.notCovered: Regexes outside the gates, and inputs shaped unlike the crafted ones.

rules.text: Every command the tracker adapter accepts has a section in the tracker contract.
rules.reason: Skills call the adapter from the contract, so an undocumented command is unusable or misused.

enforced.title: every command the OpenProject adapter accepts has a section in the tracker contract

rules.notCovered: Whether each section describes the command's behaviour correctly.

rules.text: The five PreToolUse gates block the tool call when their hook fails.
rules.reason: A gate that crashes open lets the unapproved action through.

enforced.title: the five PreToolUse gates block the tool call when their hook fails

rules.notCovered: Whether the installed Claude Code honours onFailure is re-probed by run-probes.sh, not by npm test.

rules.text: Eval graders check facts only: no LLM or baseline grader in any case.
rules.reason: An LLM judge reading the same style docs is circular and biased toward its own outputs (ADR 0007, ADR 0009).

enforced.title: eval graders check facts only: no llm or baseline grader in any case

rules.notCovered: Whether each fact grader checks the fact that matters for the case.

rules.text: Every approval before a github-write post, reply or edit carries the verbatim body in an AskUserQuestion preview.
rules.reason: The user answers for every word published under their name.

enforced.title: every approval before a github-write post, reply or edit carries the verbatim body in an AskUserQuestion preview

rules.notCovered: Publishing paths that do not go through github-write.mjs.

rules.text: Every write command line in the skills names the target that answer mode needs.
rules.reason: A one-use approval ticket matches only a command whose target it can read.

enforced.title: every write command line in the skills names the target answer mode needs

rules.notCovered: Write commands an agent composes outside the skill text.

rules.text: One blast-radius procedure sees every tracked file and reads siblings from the remote ref, and every role that traces callers points to it.
rules.reason: A fix to one caller leaves its siblings broken unless every caller is found the same way.

enforced.title: one blast-radius procedure sees every tracked file, reads siblings from the remote ref, and every role that traces callers points to it

rules.notCovered: Whether the agent runs the procedure in a session.

rules.text: Every vX.Y.Z tag holds plugin.json version X.Y.Z, and the manifest at HEAD is not behind the latest tag.
rules.reason: The installed plugin must be the version its tag names, so a rollback lands on a known release.

enforced.title: the kit's release tags match their manifests and its manifest is not behind the latest tag

rules.notCovered: Whether the release worktree is checked out at the latest tag.

rules.text: The published docs hold no dead relative link, missing repository path or line number past the end of its file.
rules.reason: A reader following a dead reference cannot use the docs.

enforced.title: the kit's published docs hold no dead link, missing path or out-of-range line

rules.notCovered: External URLs, commands shown in docs, and a line cite that is in range but points at moved text.

rules.text: No kit file names a file that git history deleted and that no longer exists under any path.
rules.reason: A reference to a retired file breaks a hook or misleads a reader.

enforced.title: no published kit file names a file the kit retired

rules.notCovered: Retired commands, flags and config keys that were never separate files.

rules.text: Each SKILL.md opens with a persona, the iron laws and a not-this-skill section naming the sibling that owns that work.
rules.reason: The agent reads who it is, what it never does and where other work belongs before any procedure.

enforced.title: every kit skill opens with a persona paragraph, then iron laws, then a not-this-skill section

rules.notCovered: Whether the not-this-skill section names the right siblings.

rules.text: A skill description stays under 1,024 characters and parses as plain YAML: no ' #' and no ': ' inside it.
rules.reason: Claude Code truncates or misreads a longer or YAML-ambiguous description, and the skill stops routing.

enforced.title: every kit skill description is under 1,024 characters and reads the same in plain YAML

rules.notCovered: A block-scalar description fails as not one line; a quoted one is measured with its quotes.

rules.text: Kit source holds no comments; tool directives are the only exception.
rules.reason: Explanations belong in the commit or PR description, where they cannot drift from the code.

enforced.title: the kit's tracked JavaScript and Python hold no comment other than a tool directive

rules.notCovered: Shell scripts and YAML files are not scanned.

rules.text: A skill is model-invocable only when the agent must reach it on its own; otherwise it sets disable-model-invocation: true.
rules.reason: Every model-invocable description costs always-loaded context and can route the wrong request.

enforced.whyNotMachine: Whether the agent must reach a skill on its own is a judgment about its use.

rules.notCovered: Everything; a reviewer checks it on each new skill.

rules.text: Every skill step ends on a checkable completion criterion, and rules are stated positively with a one-clause reason.
rules.reason: An agent stops at a step it can verify and follows a rule whose reason it can weigh.

enforced.whyNotMachine: Whether a sentence is a checkable criterion or a positive rule is a reading of natural language.

rules.notCovered: Everything; a reviewer checks it on each skill change.

rules.text: Menu labels are keys of plugin/lib/labels.mjs, never literal text.
rules.reason: A literal label skips the profile's language and drifts from the other menus.

enforced.whyNotMachine: A literal label looks like any other prose in a skill, so no pattern separates it reliably.

rules.notCovered: Everything; a reviewer checks it on each skill change.

rules.text: Every check is shown to fail on a wrong fixture before its result is trusted.
rules.reason: A check that cannot fail is the most common failure of a standard (ADR 0011).

enforced.whyNotMachine: It is a fact about how the change was made, not about the tree.

rules.notCovered: Everything; a reviewer checks that each new check has a failing fixture.

rules.text: Published text holds no home path, personal data, secret or denylisted term.
rules.reason: Anything pushed to a public repository stays public.

enforced.whyNotMachine: The denylist lives in the user's profile, outside the repository; run public-scan.mjs tree and history before a public push.

rules.notCovered: Everything npm test sees; the scan runs by hand before a push.

rules.text: After a Claude Code update, run-probes.sh re-checks the platform behaviour the hooks rely on before the kit is trusted.
rules.reason: A platform change can silently disable a gate.

enforced.whyNotMachine: It needs the live Claude Code CLI and is triggered by an update, not by a change to the tree.

rules.notCovered: Everything npm test sees.

rules.text: Eval results record the served model, and a rebaseline never lowers a pass rate except on an accepted model change.
rules.reason: A model upgrade must not launder a regression into a new baseline.

enforced.title: a rebaseline that lowers a pass rate is refused unless the model changed and the change is accepted

rules.notCovered: Eval suites other than the pressure scenarios, and runs whose trace has no model.

rules.text: Every model-gap rule names an ablation, and its verdict proposes keeping or removing the rule; nothing is deleted automatically.
rules.reason: Instructions written for an older model can hurt a newer one, so they are re-measured, not trusted forever.

enforced.title: the ablation plan keeps a model-gap rule that still helps, proposes removing one that does not, and never measures across models

rules.notCovered: Whether the ablation scenario exercises the rule as real sessions do; three runs per arm is a small sample.

rules.text: A sweep record names what it studies with '- Topic: <topic>'.
rules.reason: A sweep studies a topic; roles reuse topics, so naming the role misstates what the record covers.

enforced.title: every kit sweep record registered at a standard version with the topic line names its topic

rules.notCovered: The two records registered at version 1 keep '- Role:', and no version 2 record exists yet, so the kit check reads none today.
